project_title: Sistem Informasi & Label QR Perkebunan (Kebun LSU Management)
theme_summary: High-density plantation management system combining deep forest green structural tones, organic bone-white surfaces, crisp high-contrast emerald borders, and tactical lime/gold badges for field precision and scanability.

layout_and_spacing.density_mode: Support toggle between Compact (py-2 px-3) and Standard (py-3.5 px-4) for data table rows

login_screen.description: Clean split screen with high-res aerial palm plantation image on left and dark forest themed JWT login card on right

controls: Pencarian global (Search across Kebun, Afdeling, Blok, Code LSU)
Tombol Cetak PDF Label QR (Grid Layout)
Tombol Ekspor Tabel PDF (Full Table + QR + 2-Line Caption)

qr_code_generator.payload_format: JSON or Structured String: Kebun: {kebun} | Afdeling: {afdeling} | Blok: {blok} | LSU: {code_lsu} | X: {koord_x} | Y: {koord_y}
qr_code_generator.preview: Instant visual QR canvas rendering with download PNG button

excel_bulk_import_modal.dropzone: Drag and drop area for .xlsx or .xls files
excel_bulk_import_modal.template_download: Provide downloadable template Excel with columns [Kebun, Afdeling, Blok, Code_LSU, Koord_X, Koord_Y, Id_Actual]
excel_bulk_import_modal.preview_table: Validation table displaying imported rows before confirming save to backend

pdf_export_modes.mode_1_labels: PDF Label Stiker Field QR Cards (3x5 grid layout per page, displaying QR + Kebun/Blok/LSU label)
pdf_export_modes.mode_2_full_table: Full Data Table Report PDF containing tabular data, embedded QR code thumbnail per row, and two-line caption below each QR

coordinates_map_visualizer.description: Interactive visual plot showing Koord_X vs Koord_Y block layout grid for spatial spatial inspection

general_ui_ux_guidelines: Always use test-id attributes (data-testid) on every interactive component, modal, input, button, and table row.
Do not use transparent background on header, sticky nav, or dialog overlays. Use high contrast glassmorphism with backdrop-blur-md bg-[#0F291E]/95 or solid white with clear borders.
Use Indonesian field terminology accurately: Kebun, Afdeling, Blok, Code LSU, Koordinat X/Y, Id Actual.
Hover states must always explicitly set text colors to guarantee readability.
Ensure PDF export functions cleanly handle both single-page stickers and multi-page tabular reports without memory locks.
Use Toast notifications (sonner) for Excel upload feedback, CRUD confirmations, and PDF export status.
testing_convention: All elements must have kebab-case data-testid, e.g. data-testid='input-search-kebun', data-testid='button-export-pdf-labels', data-testid='table-row-plantation-item'.
